title: imap: credential_file secretx URI not validated at config-parse time
description: imap Config::validate() checks bcrypt hashes in auth.users but does NOT validate auth.credential_file when it is a secretx: URI. Reader's validate() calls secretx::from_uri() eagerly and returns ConfigError::Validation on a bad URI. imap defers this to build_credential_store() which runs after tracing is initialized. Consequence: a misconfigured secretx URI in imap config passes Config::from_file() with Ok, then the process exits at runtime via error\!()+exit(1) rather than surfacing the error before any other startup work. Trigger: auth.credential_file = 'secretx:///bad-uri' in imap config.
